high_level_description: The image depicts a formal meeting or diplomatic event taking place indoors. Two men are shaking hands across a table that is set with various items, including a tiered stand of food, bottles of what appears to be beverages, and some papers. The man on the left is dressed in a dark blue suit with a purple tie, while the man on the right is wearing a white shirt with a maroon vest. Both appear to be engaged in a cordial interaction. In the background, there are other individuals seated at the table, also dressed formally, suggesting a professional or governmental setting.
